messages.content:
Risk: Compromised confidential information
Description: The AI system, including its supporting compute infrastructure, may serve as an attack vector for intrusion into cyber-physical or cloud environments, or enable exfiltration of secrets.
Concern: None
Policy: Insider Threat & Cybersecurity

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/ListedSecurityIdentifier: listed security identifier — security identifier issued in the public domain and referred to in listings and other relevant publications [found by 8/9 queries]
  Siblings: international securities identification number, National Securities Identifying Number, proprietary security identifier
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Identifiers/IdentificationScheme: identification scheme — system for minting identifiers for things that specifies constraints on the structure of the identifier [found by 6/9 queries]
  Siblings: code set, indexing scheme, classification scheme
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 5/9 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000548: Vulnerability — A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in. [found by 5/9 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesListings/ListedSecurity: listed security — registered security listed on at least one exchange [from restriction: identifies on ListedSecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: preferred, restricted voting, redeemable extendable, cumulative participating, registered share, preferred, voting, exchangeable, cumulative participating, registered share, preferred, restricted voting, redeemable extendable, adjustable income, registered share
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityRegistry: security registry — registry used to manage security identifiers and related information [from restriction: isRegisteredIn on ListedSecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: transaction record, entity legal form registry, share register
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentificationScheme: security identification scheme — formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers [from restriction: isDefinedIn on ListedSecurityIdentifier]

axes.rationale: The risk explicitly mentions exfiltration of secrets, which aligns with the concept of 'Dangerous Information' - knowledge that can lead to harm when misused.
The AI system being an 'attack vector' implies the existence of a vulnerability that can be exploited. This class directly represents that concept.
